mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 9.5% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and decreases in industrial production (INDPRO) indicate strong consumer demand outpacing supply, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When HOUST increases >0.5% and INDPRO decreases <-0.3% in 30 days, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 0.3% and CPIAUCSL > 215) increases discount rates and reduces liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 0.3 and CPIAUCSL > 215.

mechanism_narrative: A positive change in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: Payroll employment growth exceeding 100,000 persons (100 in thousands) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decreases in industrial production (INDPRO) and increases in retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand with supply constraints, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO decreases <-0.3% and RSAFS increases >0.5% in 30 days, SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low industrial production (INDPRO < 100) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0) indicate a supply-constrained economy during recession, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 9.0.
